#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a dated tarball and copies it off-host.
set -eu

DEST='backup-srv:/srv/nightly'
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "error: logs directory does not exist" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Keep the archive in the working directory so a failed upload leaves it
# available for investigation or a manual retry.
tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$work/logs" "$work/bin"
printf 'nightly log\n' > "$work/logs/app.log"
cat > "$work/bin/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$SCP_ARGS_FILE"
EOF
chmod +x "$work/bin/scp"
cp backup.sh "$work/backup.sh"
(
  cd "$work"
  SCP_ARGS_FILE="$work/scp-args" PATH="$work/bin:$PATH" ./backup.sh
)
test -f "$work/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
tar -tzf "$work/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" | grep -Fx 'logs/app.log'
printf '%s\n' '--- scp arguments ---'
cat "$work/scp-args"
